app.name: StoatMD
sync.later: Cloud sync comes after the local vault works
sync.authorizing.desc: Finish in your browser, then come back here.
sync.enableDesc: Your local vault always works. Sync is optional: connect your own cloud drive to align across devices.
sync.agentHint: Recommended · your Personal Agent can read and write the same vault
sync.provider.pickDesc: Sync supports Google Drive and Dropbox: global reach, agent friendly.
sync.folder.title: Choose the remote vault folder
sync.folder.desc: Your local folder stays the same; this just adds an alignment path.
sync.disconnect.title: Disconnect sync?
sync.disconnect.desc: Local files stay untouched and you can reconnect later. Stored alignment anchors will be cleared.
sync.error.network: Network unavailable. Local editing continues; sync retries automatically.
sync.error.auth: Authorization expired. Please reconnect the drive.
sync.error.config: Cloud client credentials are missing. Finish the developer setup first.
sync.paywall.title: Sync is a paid feature
sync.paywall.desc: The local vault is free forever; cloud alignment unlocks after purchase.
sync.noVault: Open a local vault before turning on sync.
sync.conflict.title: Resolve sync conflicts
sync.conflict.desc: Both sides changed. Pick which copy to keep — nothing is overwritten silently.
sync.conflict.keepBothHint: The cloud copy is saved as "name (cloud conflict date).md"
sync.conflict.confirmDesc: The same choice will be applied to every matching conflict.
settings.title: Settings
settings.theme.desc: Colors only, layout stays put. Inspired by Slack appearance presets.
settings.font.desc: Reading font and rhythm; the source pane stays monospaced.
settings.font.preview: A good piece of writing expands a structure, not a pile of sparks.
rename.title: Rename Note
rename.desc: Only the file name changes; the content stays put. The extension is added automatically.
rename.label: File name
rename.error.empty: The file name can't be empty
rename.error.invalid: The file name can't contain / or start with .
rename.error.exists: A file with that name already exists
trash.title: Move to Trash?
trash.desc: “{name}” will move to the Trash and can be recovered from there.
vault.empty.hint: Choose a local folder as your vault. Ordinary .md files inside are read and written.
vault.conflict.title: File changed on disk
vault.conflict.description: The file on disk differs from the editor. Keep local edits to overwrite disk, or reload to discard unsaved changes.
